decision: The arrow (PD-42) is the network's net one-way growth. The site count may dip briefly when a fresh, still-unrecorded Birth is undone (7 undos in 1,735 Births in WW2's headline run). No Birth whose record has formed can be undone (PD-11/PD-38 undo guard), so the number of edge records formed and the count of record-events (PD-37) never decrease.
corrects: Claude2's question text for PD-42 said 'new sites, never fewer' - an overstatement by the coordinator.
